prospective_rule.scope: Prospective source selection before four-actor optimization-only probe
prospective_rule.compare: common-loan candidate vs qualified transpose-only driver in the same sequential seven-sample probe
prospective_rule.keep_common_loan_if: All15 correct, all execution counters exactly match transpose-only, and raw geometric-mean speedup vs transpose-only >1.0
prospective_rule.otherwise: Restore only shared-loan refactor from the saved transpose-only checkpoint; preserve every probe and qualification result
prospective_rule.formal_prerequisites: Selected source fully qualified and committed; source and driver frozen before either formal partition
prospective_rule.holdout_use: Aggregate strict acceptance only; no per-case diagnosis or tuning

scope: Selection uses all15 optimization cases only. All regressions and raw controls retained. No holdout performance used.
